title: Summary khipus
text: No khipu records the group totals or column sums of another beyond chance (384 pairs against 415.6 on the offset baseline).

title: Compilations
text: Apart from the Basel fragments, no khipu combines runs from two or more other khipus.

title: Colonial documents
text: About 2,300 numbers from roughly 70 open transcriptions match no digitized khipu.

title: Huacones-Vilcahuasi hierarchy
text: Totals of one khipu on the next are at the level of chance (offset baseline).

title: Opposite attachment in copies
text: Recto on one copy and verso on the other in 7 of 10 pairs, against 50% at random (p ≈ 0.17).

title: Same suppliers in the same order
text: Deposit sizes of different Inkawasi khipus do not correlate by position.

title: Copies respect group boundaries
text: Run endpoints fall on group boundaries in 38% of cases against 46% expected.

title: Broken cords as lower bounds
text: Sums with a broken part are exact half as often (35% vs 68%), but the sign shows no loss of knots.

title: Equal-share convention
text: Pairs of equal-total groups are not over-represented corpus-wide (p ≈ 0.1).

title: Pachacamac style vs Huacho style
text: Simple numeric features do not separate site-museum Pachacamac khipus from Huacho khipus.

title: Sign convention
text: Neither attachment side nor colour marks negative cords.

title: Syllables in non-decimal khipus
text: The non-decimal signs of Wari-style khipus have far too small an alphabet for syllables.

title: Calendar reading
text: Group and cord counts give no calendar numbers beyond chance.

title: Colour of the product
text: Colour is not carried into copies and does not mark the product at Inkawasi.
